notes: Olive-beige painted concrete loft: pilasters between two bays, framed spandrel panels, steel-sash multi-pane windows above, tall shop windows with a multi-pane transom band, glazed entry door right of centre. Khaki cast-concrete tints (warm, R>G) instead of olive-green; reflective glazing that passes some interior (glass-dark uppers, glass-film shopfront). Milky whitewashed shop glass instead of a deep dark room; olive-painted slim storefront members; the panelled spandrel band between the shop head and the upper sash now has room to draw (upper sill raised, shop head dropped); moulded pilasters with capitals and a deeper parapet band; one blank blue leasing banner straddling the spandrel at the entry bay. Storefront members on a painted-white base with an olive tint (a tint on painted-steel only darkens it to black). Smooth painted cast stone (cast-stone-trim, olive-tan) for wall, pilasters (no flutes), spandrels with moulded square panels and coping; weathering without vertical streak columns; reflection-dominant glass (glassModel: reflective uppers, dark storefront glass). Smooth painted stucco (no cast-stone grain) in pale khaki-cream, frosted white-backed shop glass on aluminium members, dark steel multi-pane sashes, darker reflective uppers, no streak weathering. Shop glass opaque dark reflective (the frosted glass read as a lit empty room); the leasing banner hangs as a flag on a steel arm turned 40 degrees (bladeSigns.flagDeg). Soot at the base, grime, faint wide streaks.
